_about.title: Inputs for the record-sharing techno-economic assessment (scripts/recompute_tea_ladder.py)
_about.currency: USD, planning values on the stated access dates; no inflation or tax model

evidence_classes.published: taken from a peer-reviewed paper or an official statistical release; source key resolves in references_zotero_dedup.bib
evidence_classes.tariff: a public price list read on the access date
evidence_classes.catalogue: a public supplier catalogue price read on the access date
evidence_classes.scenario: an analyst assumption; varied in Table S25 and the tornado panel

_about.how_to_tune: Edit any 'value' below and rerun scripts/recompute_tea_ladder.py. Strings named *_base select among documented alternatives.

cpu_hours_total_oedb.note: approximately 16 million CPU-hours of MD for the whole database

compositions_oedb.note: Li, Na and K formulations; the per-composition average is applied to the Li subspace

trajectory_gb_per_evaluation.note: approximately 50 GB of trajectory data per composition

mdx_node_points_per_hour.note: Node Occupancy Project, generic CPU node, FY2026; 1 point = 1 JPY excluding tax

mdx_cpu_pack_points_per_vcpu_hour.note: Normal Project CPU pack (1 virtual core); alternative billing basis

mdx_physical_cores_per_node.note: 2 x Intel Xeon Platinum 8368 (38 cores each) per generic CPU node, mdx system overview page

mdx_vcpu_per_node.note: 152 CPU packs (1 vCPU each) is the maximum per virtual machine; two hardware threads per physical core

mdx_highspeed_storage_points_per_gb_day.note: high-speed storage; large-capacity and object storage are free

trajectory_retention_days_sensitivity.note: only used in the optional paid-retention sensitivity row

fx_jpy_per_usd.note: declared conversion; 140 and 180 in the sensitivity table

tariff_mapping_alternatives.node_occupancy_physical_core: one published CPU-hour = one physical core-hour; node tariff divided by 76 cores
tariff_mapping_alternatives.node_occupancy_vcpu: one published CPU-hour = one hardware-thread-hour; node tariff divided by 152 vCPU
tariff_mapping_alternatives.cpu_pack_vcpu: one published CPU-hour = one CPU-pack (vCPU) hour at the Normal Project rate

rho_compute_cash_realization.note: fraction of assigned compute cost avoided by reducing future reservations; 0 = sunk reservation

electrolyte_usd_per_ml.note: salt + solvents + additives allowance including aliquoting loss; replace with masses x prices per formulation when known

cathode_sheet_pack_usd.note: single-crystal NMC811, single-sided, 10 x 10 cm, 5 sheets per pack, 21.5 mg cm-2, 3.82 mAh cm-2

punching_recovery.note: usable disc area per coated area after edge loss and punching

anode_disc_usd.note: coated graphite disc allowance; not a supplier quote

coin_cell_kit_pack_usd.note: CR2032 case + spacers + separator + spring, SS304, 100 sets

gas_waste_usd_per_package.note: glove-box gas, handling consumables and waste

assembly_yield.note: technically valid cells per attempted assembly; a valid cell with a poor electrochemical result is not a failure

channel_hours_per_attempt.note: declared allowance covering, for example, protocol A: two C/10 formation cycles (about 40 h), a C/5-C/2-1C-2C rate map with three cycles per rate (about 50 h) and 60 cycles at 1C with rests (about 150 h); or protocol B: formation plus 30 cycles at C/3 (about 240 h). Every attempted cell is charged the full allowance.

failed_preparation_hours.note: hands-on time lost when a known-intractable formulation is prepared again and fails handling

median_annual_wage_usd.note: chemists (SOC 19-2031), national median annual wage, May 2025 BLS OOH / OEWS

wage_share_of_compensation.note: wages and salaries as a share of total compensation, private industry, December 2025

eta_labor_cash_realization.note: share of released hands-on labor that actually reduces overtime, outsourcing or hiring

shared_lab_capital_usd.note: glove box, preparation and characterization equipment

discount_rate.note: end-of-year cash flows; no residual value

p_match_times_p_omit.note: probability that a progressed candidate has a protocol-matched record AND that the repeat may legitimately be omitted; 1.0 is the upper bound, so the base alpha equals the measured p_progress ceiling

reuse._note: alpha = p_progress(measured, top-k of the earlier group's own ranking) x p_match_times_p_omit unless alpha_override is a number.

electrolyte_share_of_cell_cost.note: electrolyte share of baseline pre-yield cell cost; 0.02 and 0.10 as alternatives

process_cost_example.note: added formation or process cost as a fraction of baseline pre-yield cost
